summary: budget failure on the TCP transport with the durable authority ledger: a private-directory small-file workload (5000 ops/node, 4 nodes) does not finish in 30 s (native ~2-3 s, ceiling 2x = 6 s). Every inode/AG grant and release is a durable page commit; since 0.36.0 (D-0347) each commit is 2 x SCSI COMPARE AND WRITE + 1 x 3.5 KiB FUA write + 3 flushes on the shared LUN (before 0.36.0: 1 FUA write + 1 flush + 1 readback), and a create needs several grants/releases across AG + inode + parent-dir resources. The per-commit cost has never been measured on the rig (P-TAUTH-STATS prints only at release_all/unmount).
mechanism: NOT YET MEASURED (instrument step 1). Candidates: (1) durable-commit count per create x per-commit LUN latency (CAW ~1-2 ms each on iSCSI/mpatha, flush ~1-5 ms) => 10-30 ms per create; (2) the 500 ms FREEZE_REQ cadence / handoff parking on first touch of each of the ~2115 pages (1293 P-TAUTH-ACTIVATE + 1118 REMASTER-PARKED in the s429 token sweep: every page's FIRST use pays a bootstrap-for-request round trip + 3 page writes, and a parked requester retries at 100 ms); (3) the requester retry cadence (dlm_retry sleeps) rather than a wakeup on FROZEN (GPT ruling hazard 4, docs/rulings/unowned-page-route.md).
